The '''72nd Flight''' was a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class]] [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] that served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Confederate Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Model" /> a conflict between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was fought from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The [[Flight group/Legends|flight group's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] had a [[Color/Legends|green]] and grey color scheme.<ref name="Model" />

==Behind the scenes==
72nd Flight was represented with a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|Base Set]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''<ref name="Model" />  which released on [[June 19]] [[2007]].<ref name="Date">{{WizKidsGames|url=StarWars/newsandextras/newstemplate.aspx?id=1500|text=Star Wars PocketModel TCG Releases Today!|archivedate=20071031082555}}</ref>
